tables.index_coverage_rule: Primary key counts as an already covered exact column set; no second ordinary tenant_id index.

fields.before_definition_json: nullable closed allowlisted authorization metadata<=32768bytes,never source text/token/verifier
fields.after_definition_json: nullable closed allowlisted authorization metadata<=32768bytes; preserve module scope+version history

transactions.lock_order: Unique command reservation (mutations only) -> tenant epoch rows sorted tenant ID -> current native user/membership/domain owner -> policy/module/grant/credential -> source lifecycle fences under the reconciled native order -> completed same audit receipt. Fresh final-permit read transactions use corresponding shared/current locks. Native mutators must be adapted consistently before activation.
transactions.grant_and_module_mutation: CAS expected_version, validate current issuer and exact target/lineage/live-source/publication membership under transaction, update module/immutable grant/revocation, increment tenant epoch, append audit, commit all or none. Never accept changed-row count0 as success. Grant pins module_version; module change invalidates all old-version grants and credentials/views. At most256 current live grants per module; getModuleAdmin includes only these, not retained history. Preserve previous and new bounded scope/department/grant definition metadata in audit before/after fields; credential audit uses only safe credential ID/expiry/mode/scope digest, never generic entity serialization or verifier. Authorization reads use before/after null.
transactions.department_roster: Tenant native owner only; every member must be an active exact same-tenant UserTenant row. Full replacement bounded256,expected version,CAS,epoch+audit transaction. No team wildcard or inherited department hierarchy.
transactions.credential: No epoch bump on mint/revoke/view/audit. Mint locks tenant epoch and parent grant, snapshots policy/fences, generates verifier and commits metadata+audit. Revoke sets revoked_at atomically and audit; subsequent final auth rejects its views. Cannot change grant/subject/scope in place. Mint from a live native web_and_mcp view, preserving its exact target subset and one grant; view expiry is not credential lifetime. No per-hit row-map SQL write is required: evidence digests derive from the view and verified immutable publication. Mint journal contains safe metadata only and returns token:null on replay,including after original view expiry/GC. Original transient secret is never encrypted/persisted for replay.
transactions.idempotency: All seven writes use transactions.command_receipts; remove separate Grant/credential request-key maps. No name-based,process-local or CAS-only replay recovery.

command_receipts.table: knowledge_access_audit (same row carries mutation audit + command receipt; no tenth table or new HTTP operation)
command_receipts.unique: Named UNIQUE(actor_user_id,command_operation,command_key). Key is unique across scopes for one actor+operation. Exact scope is stored and included in the validated request binding; using that key for another scope/body is409,not a second mutation.
command_receipts.nullable: All command fields null for ordinary audit events; SQL UNIQUE NULL semantics allow multiple read events. Committed command rows require non-null actor,operation,key,request SHA,scope,state and safe result. Pending rows exist only inside the transaction and are never committed.
command_receipts.request_SHA: SHA256 UTF8 JSON array[knowledge-access-command/0.3.0,actual_actor_user_id,operation,canonical_validated_request_DTO]. Stable DTO field order,all declared nullable keys,arrays preserve order; reject unknown/duplicate/bad UTF8/unsafe numbers before canonicalization. No raw auth header/secret in digest input or stored request.

scope.createCredential: domain/tenant captured from native view on first execution; from committed receipt on replay even after view GC
scope.revokeCredential: credential native-self metadata scope,not a client-supplied foreign domain

algorithm: Authenticate current native actor and validate canonical DTO/key. Query committed actor+operation+key; compare SHA and current management authorization for stored scope before returning any stored safe data. Do not require an expired original view/CAS version for an already committed exact replay.

If no committed receipt,begin transaction and reserve unique actor+operation+key as pending_uncommitted. Concurrent identical/different-body requests serialize on this unique key; a duplicate after the winner commits loads that winner through a fresh primary read and returns replay or409. A rolled-back reservation leaves no command.

Resolve and authorize exact tenant/domain/self scope. Acquire tenant state and resource locks under the documented global order,check expected version/current view/dependency closure,perform one mutation,increment epoch only if required and actually changed.

In the same transaction write before/after safe audit metadata and completed command receipt with resource ID,status and ORIGINAL safe result data. Record token:null for mint. Commit atomically. No committed source/Grant/credential/epoch change may exist without its receipt.

Release first response from transient result after commit. Same-key exact replay rebuilds a fresh response envelope with current request_id and stored original safe data; no mutation,no second resource/no additional epoch bump. createGrant replay200; set/revoke replay200; credential mint replay200 with token:null.

Current management authorization is always rechecked: tenant owner for department,current actual domain owner for policy/module/Grant,current native self credential metadata authority for mint/revoke. No replay of source content and no owner impersonation.

If the database response leaves commit unknown,return unavailable,data:null,outcome_known:false,retry_same_key:true. Preserve first failure. Retry EXACT operation/payload/key against the primary; wait/resolve the same unique reservation. A primary-unavailable or still-in-flight outcome remains unknown; never infer rollback from a cache or generate a new key/secret.
command_receipts.failures: Prevalidation/CAS/auth failures and transactions known rolled back do not consume a command key; state and receipt both absent. An uncertain outcome is not labelled rolled back. Replays of a completed command are checked before stale expected_version and never change the winner result.
command_receipts.retention: Keep complete safe receipt data90days. Ordinary audit events may follow the separate90day policy. Thereafter command row may compact to nonsecret actor/operation/key/request SHA/scope/resource/outcome tombstone; the unique key is retained indefinitely until explicit metadata-retirement scope. Exact replay of a compacted command returns409 idempotency_conflict,outcome_known:true,retry_same_key:false and NEVER executes again; no source/secret reconstruction. No automatic key deletion or reuse.
command_receipts.credential_lookup: listCredentials with idempotency_key joins the same actor/createCredential/key journal to command_resource_id and owned credential metadata. It is not a second key store. Missing/compacted metadata never causes another mint.

migration.action: Add the nine narrow metadata tables with explicit named unique indexes; compare existing indexes by complete column set. No renaming existing indexes; SQLite/MySQL dry-run probes and migration tests required later. Include the named audit-command unique column set and nullable noncommand semantics. Remove duplicate tenant_state tenant_id ordinary index; remove Grant/credential alternate request key maps.

Initialize tenant epoch rows0 lazily with conflict-safe insert; no department/module/grant/credential backfill. Missing domain policy defaults disabled. No modification of source bytes, owner-only grants, permissions or old publications.

Wire all existing native user/tenant membership/tenant/domain status mutations affecting shared access to epoch bump in same transaction. Live checks remain mandatory defense. Do not import inherited Python logic or create a second schema owner.
Apply new handler/service/projection/order/log policy behind default-off configuration; existing endpoints and frozen documents unchanged. Original content/ES mappings not recreated.

After specific decision and synthetic tests, owner explicitly enables sharing, creates module from an existing valid publication, creates grant; users explicitly mint short-lived credentials. No production account or secret seeded.

rollback: Disable new sharing policy/routes, revoke credentials/grants, expire views. Preserve tables/audit for evidence; no destructive down migration, source deletion, credential recreation, volume deletion or reclassification of native datasets.
retention: Expired view rows may be collected after a bounded1hour grace using their expires_at index. No stored content text in view/audit; mapping only. Audit90day retention is a proposed policy, cleanup requires its own operational scope. Grant/credential metadata retained through audit period with verifier cleared only after revoked+expired retention rule; no secret ever exists in DB. Historical module versions remain traceable through exact before/after authorization definitions; audit digests alone are insufficient after a module scope overwrite. Command receipt/tombstone retention follows the distinct non-reuse rule in transactions.command_receipts; ordinary audit GC must not remove command uniqueness or trigger a replay mutation.
DB_relational_checks: All relationships same tenant/domain unless explicitly nullable audit metadata. Database FKs where existing cross-engine migration supports them; application transaction validation always required.
One current module record, version changes invalidate views; old scope definition retained only as bounded authorization metadata in audited mutation record or archival metadata, never content bytes.
No TTL cache authorizes; current DB liveness checks at start/final. DB outage blocks shared result, including a cached result.
